todos.content: Initialize Next.js project with TypeScript and all dependencies (Stripe, Supabase, geolib, turf, socket.io)
Set up environment configuration (.env.local) with all required variables
Create Supabase database migrations (users, cleaners, bookings, services, cleaner_locations, payments tables with PostGIS)
Implement Stripe Payment Integration - Payment Intents with Server Actions
Implement Stripe Connect for marketplace payouts to cleaners
Create Stripe webhook handler for payment events
Build Supabase Realtime cleaner GPS tracking with geohashing + PostGIS optimization
Create live booking tracking dashboard component
Implement service booking flow (browse, select, book, pay)
Create P&L tracking system and dashboard
Set up authentication with Supabase Auth
Create main layout and UI components with Tailwind CSS
Review, test, and optimize all code
